## Checklist
- [ ] Every new paper has a DOI (or a stable URL if no DOI exists)
- [ ] `npm run check:dois` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (schema + evidence policy)
- [ ] Evidence notes are in my own words and describe what the paper actually found
- [ ] I read the paper (not just the abstract) for any `refutes` or `mixed` finding
